main_text.l: Typus Doctrina de Syllogismo Communi & Speciali vero.
Communiter sub solius formæ conditione, eftque
Indirectus, seu Primarius ducens ad impossibile.
Directus Enthymema, Confecutio Sententiarum, Inductio, Sorites.
Specialiter sub certa materia conditione, eftque Verus qui vel
Contingens, qui vel ex voce Definitione nominis. Coniugatis.

page.notes: Page is rotated; the diagram was transcribed as outline boxes. Some small glyphs (braces, daggers ††, asterisks **) are approximate. Labels such as "Tertia pars logicæ" and "397" are printed at top left. Several words in the diagram are hard to read at this scan angle and may be imperfect.
